evidence_quotes.quote: The conditions of informal settlements determine, to some extent, the nature of the water and sanitation infrastructure.
Some informal settlements develop spontaneously, with little government intervention or planning and little information regarding the residents of the area or the plots on which dwellings are built.
The consequence is that, where infrastructure expansion for these settlements is authorised and financed, the practical and technical difficulty of development is significant.
